system.description: The conjurer reaches an important insight into the vitner art, which increases their ability to draw in vitner from the surroundings. The conjurer must have a minimum level of 1 in one of the other specialties: Hwitalja, Darkhwitalja, or Vaagritalja. They increase its capacity by +10 Vitner Points per level of Vitner Habit.
system.summary: Deepens mastery of vitner craft to increase the ability to draw on surrounding energies.
